question: queue/20261030-1744-expand-storage-1b93-u02-q02: what is the measured time to first byte of a Google Cloud Storage ARCHIVE read, in milliseconds?
why: the storage classes page states only 'available within milliseconds, not hours or days' and no figure; a measured value needs a bucket, which needs a billing account (unverified: behind a sign-up). The Always Free transfer question is answered in the draft: the 100 GB North America line names no storage class and the page excludes only Rapid, so it covers Archive reads from us-central1, while the USD 0.05 per GiB retrieval fee and Class B operations are not free
